paragraphs.en: Tiny engine, immense model. colibri runs very large open models on the machine you already have. A mixture-of-experts model of hundreds of billions of parameters uses only a small part of itself for each token, so colibri keeps that part in RAM and reads the rest, the experts, from the disk when the model asks for them. Pure C, one file per model family, no GPU required.
paragraphs.zh: 极小的引擎，极大的模型。colibri 能在你已有的机器上运行非常大的开源模型。 数千亿参数的专家混合模型在每个 token 上只使用自身的一小部分，因此 colibri 将这一部分保存在内存中，当模型需要时，再从磁盘读取其余部分，也就是各个专家。 纯 C 语言编写，每个模型家族一个文件，无需 GPU。

paragraphs.en: A mixture-of-experts model is huge on disk and small per token. GLM-5.2 has 744B parameters, uses about 40B for each token, and only about 11 GB of those change from one token to the next: the routed experts.
paragraphs.zh: 混合专家模型在磁盘上非常庞大，但每个 token 的计算量却很小。 GLM-5.2 拥有 744B 参数，每个 token 约使用 40B 参数，而其中从一个 token 到下一个 token 之间只有约 11 GB 会发生变化：即被路由到的专家部分。

sents.en: GLM-5.2 has 744B parameters, uses about 40B for each token, and only about 11 GB of those change from one token to the next: the routed experts.

paragraphs.en: So the model does not have to fit in fast memory; it has to be placed . The dense part (attention, shared experts, embeddings) stays in RAM. The routed experts stay on the disk and are read when the router asks for them, through a cache that learns which experts your work uses. A GPU, when there is one, holds the hottest experts and the dense layers. Where a weight sits changes how fast the answer comes, not which weights or which router decisions produce it.
paragraphs.zh: 因此模型不必完全装进快速内存；它只需要被恰当地放置。 稠密部分（注意力、共享专家、嵌入）留在内存（RAM）中。 路由专家留在磁盘上，当路由器需要它们时才被读取，读取过程通过一个缓存进行，该缓存会学习你的工作负载常用哪些专家。 如果有 GPU，它保存最常用的专家和稠密层。 权重放在哪里只会改变答案返回的速度，而不会改变产生该答案的是哪些权重或哪些路由决策。

paragraphs.en: Why: to run models of this size on hardware people already own, to watch them work (the dashboard shows every expert as it fires), and to keep the engine small enough that anyone can measure it and make it faster. colibri is also an open research platform: an optimisation earns its place with a reproducible end-to-end measurement, and the default policy never silently changes model precision or router semantics. Less fast memory may cost speed; it must not quietly redefine the model. How it works has the details.
paragraphs.zh: 为什么：是为了在人们已有的硬件上运行这种规模的模型，是为了观察它们的工作过程（仪表盘会显示每个专家何时被触发），也是为了让引擎足够小，任何人都能测量它并让它变得更快。colibri 也是一个开放的研究平台：一项优化只有通过可复现的端到端测量才能证明其价值，且默认策略绝不会静默改变模型精度或路由器语义。 更少的快速内存可能牺牲速度；但它绝不能悄悄改变模型的定义。 它如何工作一节有详细说明。

paragraphs.en: An integrated GPU shares the CPU's RAM. What it saves is the work and the disk reads of the experts it holds, so it pays on a model like Qwen3.6, and a small model whose experts already sit in RAM, like OLMoE, can lose. That is why the setup turns Vulkan on for an integrated GPU only for Qwen3.6, Qwen3-Coder and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, and why each engine decides for itself whether to run the dense chain there (Qwen3.6 yes, Qwen3.8 no). --backend vulkan asks for Vulkan anyway.
paragraphs.zh: 集成显卡与 CPU 共享内存（RAM）。 它省下的是其所承载的专家模型的计算工作和磁盘读取，所以在 Qwen3.6 这类模型上是划算的，而像 OLMoE 这种专家权重已经驻留在内存中的小模型反而可能受损。 这就是为什么该配置只在 Qwen3.6、Qwen3-Coder 和 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 上为集成显卡开启 Vulkan，也是为什么每个引擎自行决定是否在集成显卡上运行稠密链（Qwen3.6 是，Qwen3.8 否）。--backend vulkan 则无论如何都请求使用 Vulkan。

paragraphs.en: Turning the GPU on or off. coli setup --backend vulkan uses the GPU for any model, and coli setup --backend cpu (or --no-gpu ) keeps everything on the CPU. An engine built with Vulkan uses the GPU only with COLI_VULKAN=1 in the environment of coli chat , serve or web (the setup sets it when it chose Vulkan); without it, the engine runs on the CPU. With the GPU on, COLI_VK_CHAIN=0 keeps the expert tier and runs the dense layers on the CPU. On an integrated GPU, try both: on a laptop with an Intel Iris Xe (Core i7-1355U), Qwen3.6 decoded 2.1 tok/s on the CPU, 1.7 to 1.9 with Vulkan, and 2.1 with the dense chain off.

paragraphs.en: Cards without Resizable BAR now work. Such a card (every Turing card, Ampere cards on their launch firmware, older AMD cards with the option off) lets the CPU write only about 256 MB of its memory directly; colibri now copies the weights in through a staging buffer, on its own. The path is tested by forcing it and by emulating the small window on three devices, and it costs nothing measurable on the 780M; it has not been measured on a card without Resizable BAR ( vulkan.md ).
paragraphs.zh: 不支持 Resizable BAR 的显卡现在可以工作了。 这类显卡（所有 Turing 显卡、处于出厂固件的 Ampere 显卡、关闭该选项的较旧 AMD 显卡）只允许 CPU 直接写入其显存中约 256 MB 的部分；colibri 现在会自行通过一个暂存缓冲区将权重复制进去。 该路径已通过强制启用以及在三个设备上模拟小窗口的方式进行了测试，并且在 780M 上没有可测量的开销；尚未在无 Resizable BAR 的显卡上进行过测量（vulkan.md）。

paragraphs.en: CI checks every engine's Vulkan path against the CPU's tokens on a software driver. The GPU adds numbers in a different order, and keeps some activations in f32 where the CPU rounds them, so a long answer can drift from the CPU's by a word ( vulkan.md ).
paragraphs.zh: CI 在软件驱动上针对 CPU 的 token 验证每个引擎的 Vulkan 路径。 GPU 以不同的顺序对数字求和，并将部分激活值保留在 f32，而 CPU 会对其进行舍入，因此长答案可能与 CPU 的结果相差一个词（vulkan.md）。

paragraphs.en: Most of what people ask a model for is a choice, not a paragraph: which queue, which verdict, yes or no. POST /v1/systemone takes a state (text or JSON) and typed questions, and answers each one with the probability of every allowed option and a confidence. Nothing is generated, so no answer can fall outside your list, and "the model is not sure" is a number you can put a threshold on.
paragraphs.zh: 人们向模型请求的大多数是一个选择，而不是一段文字：选哪个队列、下哪种判定、是还是否。 POST /v1/systemone 接收一个状态（文本或 JSON）和带类型的问题，并为每个问题给出每个允许选项的概率以及一个置信度。 什么都不生成，因此任何答案都不会落出你的选项列表，而「模型不确定」是一个你可以设阈值的数字。

The request and the reply are those of TypeSafe's Jev API, so a Jev client switches to colibri by changing its base URL and nothing else: TYPESAFE_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8000 (the key it already sends is accepted by a server started without COLI_API_KEY ). paragraphs.en: Every layer of every token walks the same five steps: route, union, place, overlap, learn. The design goal is that placement only ever decides speed : the router's decisions and the weights' precision are the same whether an expert answered from VRAM, from RAM or from disk.

paragraphs.en: colibri wants frontier models to depend less on scarce hardware and to cost less to run. That means changing how weights are stored and moved, deciding what lives in VRAM, RAM or storage, overlapping CPU and GPU work, and testing new ways to decode. Nothing is kept because it is conventional, and nothing is adopted because a microbenchmark looks fast: the deciding result is end-to-end inference on real machines, with quality measured alongside speed. The open questions:
paragraphs.zh: colibri 希望前沿模型更少依赖稀缺硬件，并降低运行成本。 这意味着改变权重的存储与传输方式，决定哪些内容放在显存、内存或存储中，重叠 CPU 与 GPU 的工作，并尝试新的解码方法。 不因惯例而保留任何东西，也不因微基准测试看起来很快而采用任何东西：决定性的结果是在真实机器上进行的端到端推理，质量与速度一同被衡量。待解决的开放性问题：
